title: A Non-compact Positivity-Preserving Numerical Scheme for Elliptic Differential Equations Based on Mathematical Expectation
summary: We propose a novel non-compact, positivity-preserving scheme for linear non-divergence form elliptic equations. Based on the Feynman--Kac formula, the solution is represented as a conditional expectation associated with a diffusion process.Instead of using compact Markov chain approximations, we construct a wide-stencil scheme by approximating the expectation with carefully designed transition probabilities, ensuring both consistency and positivity preservation.
